target.reference: original frozen DUET on full R2R val_unseen

probe.perturbation: same label-free SHA selection of a legal nonSTOP nonargmax action at zero-index step 2 as E2; retain unapplied cases
probe.early_terminal: retain original trajectory; perturb condition terminal before step 3 has no intervention states
probe.candidate_rule: original executed action, top two finite legal nonbaseline nonSTOP actions ordered by descending original logit then viewpoint ID, and STOP; deduplicate
probe.forced_terminal: when no_vp_left or decision step 14, executed action is STOP and moving candidates are prohibited
probe.continuation: replay exact executed prefix; force candidate once; thereafter unmodified frozen DUET without further external perturbation
probe.stop_semantics: original DUET STOP and discovered-graph historical return; preserve unmodified STOP probabilities even when forcing action
probe.baseline_anchor_check: replay every selected state's original-action branch; compare full path and metrics with original condition trajectory
probe.prefix_check: compare viewpoint, candidate identities, legal masks and original logits before action replacement
probe.label_policy: ground truth and future branch observations used only after rollout for outcomes; unavailable to candidate/state selection or policy input
probe.metric_policy: existing pinned DUET evaluator on complete executed path including intermediate edges and historical return

report.unit: original instruction; report splits and conditions separately; aggregate original instruction union only with explicit deduplication
outcomes: label-only best achievable SR with per-instruction nondecreasing SPL
report.oracle_warning: a hindsight opportunity bound on selected training-scene states; never a learned method result or prediction of unseen SR
report.decision: use this finite probe to decide whether action/label collection merits a larger training experiment; no automatic +5 claim from perturbation recovery
